voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: South Pacific, November nineteen fifty-five. A small ship was found drifting north of Fiji. Everyone aboard was gone.
The Joyita had left Samoa five weeks earlier, on a two-day run to Tokelau, with twenty-five people aboard.
She was found more than six hundred miles off course, partly submerged, kept afloat by the cork lining her hull.
Her radio was tuned to the distress frequency. The clocks had stopped at ten twenty-five. The life rafts were gone.
No one aboard was ever found. The inquiry called their fate inexplicable on the evidence.
